info.title: Required oneOf and anyOf outline
info.description: Required body fields for the missing red validation border. plain_string is the control. Every other required field is a oneOf or anyOf shape that stays gray when empty.

post.description: plain_string is a required string and shows the red border when empty. The other required fields are oneOf or anyOf shapes and do not.

AmountOneOf.description: oneOf of number and string, referenced by ref_oneof.

plain_string.description: Control. Required type string. An empty value shows the red border.

oneof_number_string.description: Required oneOf of number and string. Same shape as ShaBaas Pay amount. An empty value does not show the red border.

oneof_single_string.description: Required oneOf with a single string branch. An empty value does not show the red border.

anyof_number_string.description: Required anyOf of number and string. An empty value does not show the red border.

nullable_oneof.description: Required nullable oneOf of number and string. An empty value does not show the red border.

type_plus_oneof.description: Required type number next to a oneOf of number and string. An empty value does not show the red border.

nested_object.description: Required object. Expand it and leave inner_oneof empty. That input does not show the red border.

inner_oneof.description: Required oneOf of number and string nested in nested_object. An empty value does not show the red border.

oneof_string_or_array.description: Required oneOf of string and array of strings. An empty value does not show the red border.
